gold_text: Clash Royale PvP Battle in Card Tower Duel Free In-App Purchases Enter the Arena! Build your Battle Deck and outsmart the enemy in fast real-time battles. From the creators of CLASH OF CLANS comes a real-time multiplayer battle game starring your favourite Clash characters and more. Start battling against players from around the world! BECOME A MASTER OF STRATEGY AND DECK BUILDING Choose unique Cards to your Battle Deck and head to the Arena for Battle! Place your Cards right and knock down the enemy King and Princesses from their Towers in a strategic and fast-paced match. COLLECT AND UPGRADE 100+ CARDS Hog Rider! Collect and upgrade 100+ Cards featuring the Clash of Clans troops, spells and defences you know and love and many others. Win battles and progress to new Arenas to unlock powerful new Cards to your collection! BATTLE YOUR WAY TO THE TOP Battle your way to the League and Global Tournaments to match against the best players in the world. Compete for glory and rewards! SEASONAL EVENTS Unlock new Seasonal items like Tower Skins, Emotes and powerful Magic Items with the Season Pass and participate in fun Challenges that put your skills to the test! JOIN A CLAN AND GO TO WAR Join or form a Clan with other players to share Cards and battle in Clan Wars for BIG rewards! See you in the Arena! PLEASE NOTE! Clash Royale is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money. If you don't want to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings. The game also includes random rewards. X Notice of Access Permission: [Optional permission] Clash Royale may request permission via in game pop-ups to access your camera and send you notifications. Camera: For in-game scanning of QR codes Notifications: For sending notifications related to the game Consent is optional and you can use the app and play the game regardless of whether or not you consent. You may refuse to give consent within the game. However, certain app features may not work properly if you refuse optional access permissions"A network connection is also required. Supercell's awesome card battler delivers excellent deck-building mechanics and fast-paced fights in a package that's easy to understand and undeniably fun. Upgrading, unlocking and experimenting with cards gives the game endless replayability, and deciding just where to drop your heroes makes each battle distinct. But no matter how good your deck is, there's no substitute for skill and quick thinking. War is still broken 01/15/2021 I have a love/hate relationship with this game but it is still my single favorite mobile game. However, the matchmaking in War is beyond broken. Probably half the time, I am playing decks with an average level 2-3 higher than mine. I'm not sure that I have ever written a game review but I am hoping Supercell's developers hear enough reviews like this to actually make a change. It is all but impossible to overcome a deck with all level 13 when you have a mix of 10 and 11. It's gotten to the point that I usually just quit as soon as it becomes obvious that the person I am playing against isn't terrible because I just have nearly 0% chance to win otherwise. Not only do they have better cards typically, I will go and check the player profile afterwards and they often have many more trophies than I do. You know a matchmaking system is broken when you are consistently outgunned and compete against players with higher achievements/skill in the game. I really can't make sense of the matchmaking algorithm. I am sure they put a ton of work into it but it is about as bad as it gets. This is only in reference to war. Single player matchmaking is actually pretty good. As background, I actually play 6 accounts ranging from 4300 trophies on my lowest to a high of 5800 on my best account. The only reason I even play war is to get points for my clan and because I don't want to let them down. I HATE having to play war and definitely wouldn't if I wasn't in a clan. Supercell, PLEASE FIX. Favorite app ever I personally love this app. I have had it for over 4 years, and it's been an app I use daily. If you are thinking about getting it, for sure get the Premium plan, no ads, endless skipping of songs, shuffle play, and a good amount of more things. One thing I will say is frustrating is the constant change of the like button to songs, they removed the heart for whatever reason and with that they made adding a song to a playlist but not your liked songs a lot harder, with a drop down feature you have to scroll down to find the playlist you want. I will say that I love that you can get to choose if you want your playlists public or not because let's be honest some playlists do not need to see the light of day but can still be enjoyed in peace. I also like what they did with the front page, being able to just swipe right to click onto our profile and access our settings much easier. My most favorite feature that might not be new but I did just discover, is on that same page where we access the settings and our profile there is this "Recents" tab where you can go and see all of the songs you've listened to and the amount of times I've used it to find a song I liked in someone else's playlist, or a podcast episode I was listening to but didn't save, my lord I love that feature so much. But overall it's a really good app and something that if you get it, it will be used in your daily life if you are a fanatic music listener. I love the app but not so much the new update. Please give us a retro date. Also the option to go to your liked songs library and not all your playlist with out liked songs as a playlist. To add whenever I like a album the songs do not save, I have to like each song individually for it to save to my library, or "liked songs playlist". Whenever I click on the artist it only shows me the artist I follow and then artist suggestions based on music I like. Please just go back to when we click on artist it shows us all artist that we have saved in our library. Or simply JUST A RETRO-DATE FROM AROUND LIKE 2016 please. And the hearts next to the liked songs make no sense when we already know that they are liked songs. You can easily click on it by accident and not remember what song you deleted. The queue should show what songs you recently listened to. Not saying it should show every last song you listened to but at leas like the last 20, just a suggestion to make the app better. Lastly theres only alphabetical quick scroll on our liked songs "playlist", which should just be a music library as stated before. We need alphabetical quick scroll in all playlist, or at least the ones we decide to put in alphabetical order. Also you should add back the "skip song" when adding an album to a playlist with a song from the album already in it. We only have the option of canceling adding the album to the playlist or just hit add anyway. When will people behind apps realize theres never a need for a unnecessary update. Stop changing the way the queue works every single time I use this app! I swear Im this close to subscribing to apple music . Just let me keep the option to play my liked songs randomly or not. Also why did I suddenly lose the option to play my liked songs based on genre ?! You guys are killing me with the constant changes. Heres what the people want! To be able to play my liked songs randomly or in or order !!! I like the option sometimes! I also still want to be able to sort my liked songs by genre. Why did that suddenly go away !? I used to like the way you could channel what you want based your mood 'like "happy"' and whatnot but whatever, I could deal with the changes you made for whatever reason. Can you please stop changing the way liked songs work every single time I use this app !!!! Its so frustrating when I cant play my liked songs randomly all of a sudden and now I cant play my liked based on genre. FOR WHAT REASON !!!!! Stop making stupid changes all the time! You're pushing your people to apple music, I swear. I have subscriptions to you both but I still dont want to start using them over you, but I will. All I ask for is some consistency !! I want to be able to play my liked songs by genre, and I want to be able to consistently play my liked songs randomly or in order. I dont know why you change these all the time but you are really pushing to start using apple music or even soundcloud. Keep the consistent good features, and stop changing for the worse all the time! Data Linked to You What's New> We're always making changes and improvements to Spotify. That's just something that irks me because I don't know any other languages and there's no way to put it so I can be with those who only speak english as well. Another thing I think should be added is how the footsteps sound. I think there should be a sort of perk we can find where it silences your footsteps, but the enemy can still see the footsteps on the map, just can't hear them. It's still an advantage for both parties. Another thing is with the cars, I think there should be more window security because you can easily be shot through the car with no windows .. and that's no fun right? I also think when you find a car you should be able to have a gas can right next to it because finding a gas can in a house is pretty hard. And I think there could be different models of cars added! Like a truck for example. That's just what I think though! I hope this can be seen and taken into consideration, thank you! So I've played PUBG (counting console and mobile) for nearly 4 years and I've loved every minute of playing! PUBG is such a fun game to play either by yourself or with friends. I'm such a big PUBG fan that I bought a poster and keychains of it! I love how realistic the gameplay is, and the graphics are amazing. Like I said in the title, I LOVE PUBG! -- Edit: I received a developer response, and I noticed it said to give out some suggestions for PUBG, and I couldn't really come up with much besides one little problem. I understand Warface is not PUBG, but I would love it if the vaulting and mantling was the same. Now every time I watch something, I have to turn subtitles back on, even if it's the same movie that I just started earlier that day. If you're going to make it that subtitles are automatically off, then at least make it a setting option to have them automatically on vs automatically off. I'm someone that uses subtitles all the time, and I've never had to turn them back on for the same movie every time I re-open the app and press resume. Every other streaming app and previously prime video too, if you turn subtitles on once for one movie or show, they stay on for everything until you turn them back off. That's how it used to be and that is better. Now I have to hit pause, turn subtitles on, go back 10-30 seconds, then I can resume my movie with subtitles on. At least make an option in settings to have subtitles automatically on or off, plus the ability to change it for an individual movie or show. Also it's buffering and lagging more than before. In my case, it could be the area I'm in bc I have no wifi and most places have poor cell service, but prime video is still acting up more than any other streaming apps I use. I've never had any issues before, and if subtitles worked properly, I would give it a 5 star rating. But I use subtitles all the time and now I'm annoyed and irritated every time I start a movie or tv show. Fix them please, they worked fine before.
